rules.title: Berkeley Rent Stabilization and Eviction for Just Cause Ordinance – rent control coverage
rules.requirement: Rent control applies to most units in multifamily buildings built before 1980 and to older single-family homes with tenancies that began before 1996. Newer buildings (CO after June 1980), condos, newer single-family tenancies and certain subsidized units are not rent controlled.
citation_aliases: Berkeley Rent Stabilization and Eviction for Just Cause Ordinance
rules.quoted_span: Most units in multifamily properties built before 1980** Fully Covered Yes Yes Yes Yes
rules.conflict_note: Table says 'built before 1980' for full coverage and 'Certificate of Occupancy after June 1980' for new construction; exact cutoff (1980 vs June 1980) is ambiguous. Ordinance chapter number is not stated in the document. Local rent control supersedes the state Tenant Protection Act cap for covered units.
rules.key_value: Rent control for pre-1980 multifamily units; not for post-June-1980 CO units

rules.title: Berkeley Rent Stabilization and Eviction for Just Cause Ordinance – just cause coverage
rules.requirement: Just cause for eviction applies to nearly all rental units, including newer construction, condos, and newer single-family tenancies. Exempt: golden duplexes, owner-shared kitchen/bath units, certain ADU properties, university housing and nonprofit cooperatives.
citation_aliases: Berkeley Rent Stabilization and Eviction for Just Cause Ordinance
rules.quoted_span: New construction: units that were built and received a Certificate of Occupancy after June 1980** Partially Covered Yes No Yes Yes
rules.conflict_note: Chapter number not stated in the document.
rules.key_value: Just cause applies to both fully and partially covered units

rules.title: Berkeley ordinance – security deposit interest coverage
rules.requirement: Landlords of covered Berkeley units, including newer construction and condos, must pay interest on security deposits. Exempt units include golden duplexes, owner-shared kitchen/bath units, university housing and nonprofit cooperatives.
citation_aliases: Berkeley Rent Stabilization and Eviction for Just Cause Ordinance
rules.quoted_span: Most condominiums** Partially Covered Yes No Yes Yes
rules.conflict_note: Document gives only coverage for deposit interest, not the rate or the exact code section.

parsed.doc_summary: Berkeley Rent Board coverage guide table: which unit types are covered by registration, rent control, just cause eviction and security deposit interest under the Rent Stabilization and Eviction for Just Cause Ordinance. No algorithmic, screening or fee rules.
